Color test changes a middle node green, then selects the blue Proposal node. Inspect whether the properties panel actually indicates the current color.
Atomic deletion supplement explicitly selects the full original graph with a correctly bounded marquee; Undo is followed immediately by editing without snapshot restore.
Judge the exact assertions, and do not infer results only from button presence.
